ucl.method: Joint leagues + Europe model blended with Elo

summary: Across 1,752 league matches in 2025-26, the model's favourite won 53% of the time (bookmakers' closing-odds favourite: 53%).
Its single most likely scoreline was exactly right in 13% of matches; the real score was in its top 3 in 33%.
On probability quality (log loss 0.993 vs 0.978, lower is better) it is a little worse than the closing bookmaker prices, which are the toughest public benchmark.
Factors that improved accuracy and are switched on: xG (Understat).
Tested but dropped (no measurable gain): Elo blend (own ratings), Rest days, Injuries.
Champions League (2025-26, 189 matches): favourite won 59%, exact score 10%, top-3 score 24%.
